scope: Eight review findings fixed; synthetic tests only; no production database, deployment or migration

checks.command: xcodebuild -project ios/RAI/RAI.xcodeproj -scheme RAI -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=<dedicated-empty-simulator>" -derivedDataPath .local/review-fixes-derived -resultBundlePath .local/review-fixes-unit.xcresult -only-testing:RAITests -parallel-testing-enabled NO test

regressions: Route skew seals and publishes analysis without changing raw points/manifests; out-of-tolerance registration rejected
Saved association uploads with readHealth=false and no HealthKit calls
Normal BatchBuilder series page executes concurrently; confirmed partial receipts survive 429 and restart; final page receipt gates anchor
Single parent activity falls back to actual segment events; gaps are not invented
HealthKit lap=3 / segment=7 accepted; pause/resume request=8 ignored
Duplicate HR intervals counted once; conflicting overlaps excluded from exposure and confidence
Pending/failed detail and series preserve raw facts and omit derived results; publication releases them
Planned Effort fallback labeled at confidence 0.4; actual RPE remains null in load and override
not_verified: Background, force-kill and network-loss recovery on physical device
UI screenshot and accessibility visual regression
